name: Pork Chops with Dried Fruit
description: A savory and sweet dish featuring pork chops cooked with assorted dried fruits in a flavorful orange juice sauce.
recipeIngredient: 1½ cups assorted dried fruit (apples, peaches, pears, apricots, raisins)

recipeInstructions.text: Heat a large skillet over medium-high heat. Add oil and cook pork chops until golden brown on each side, about 6 to 8 minutes per side. Remove chops to a plate.
Reduce heat, add 1 cup orange juice to the skillet, and scrape any browned bits from the pan. Bring to a boil.
Add the remaining orange juice, dried fruit, Worcestershire sauce, and allspice. Simmer for 15 minutes.
Mix cornstarch with a small amount of water or juice. Stir into the skillet and cook until the sauce thickens, about 15 minutes.
Return pork chops to the skillet and cook until heated through. Serve with rice or couscous.

keywords: pork chops, dried fruit, orange juice sauce, savory sweet dish

_similar.name: Sour 'N Sweet Pork Chops
_similar.description: A tangy and sweet pork chop dish simmered in a rich sauce made with brown sugar, vinegar, and Worcestershire sauce.

recipeInstructions.text: Drain excess fat from pork chops and brown them in a large frying pan.
Mix together water, brown sugar, vinegar, Worcestershire sauce, and ketchup. Pour over the browned chops.
Simmer for 30 minutes or until done.
If desired, thicken the liquid with 2 Tbsp flour. Serve with rice.

_similar.keywords: sour sweet pork chops, tangy pork, brown sugar sauce

_similar.name: Yummy Country-Style Ribs
_similar.description: A flavorful and tender country-style ribs recipe marinated in a mixture of soy sauce, orange juice, and spices, then grilled to perfection.

recipeInstructions.text: Combine all marinade ingredients except the ribs in a bowl. Mix well.
Place ribs in a shallow dish and cover with the marinade. Refrigerate for 24 hours, turning meat occasionally.
Remove ribs from marinade and place on barbecue grill. Cook over low heat for about 1 hour, brushing with marinade occasionally.
Close barbecue hood and continue cooking until done, about 15 minutes more.

_similar.keywords: country-style ribs, marinated ribs, BBQ ribs

_similar.name: Oven Barbecued Pork Chops
_similar.description: Pork chops marinated in a barbecue sauce and baked in the oven.

recipeInstructions.text: Trim fat from pork chops and place in a single layer in a 13x9 inch baking dish.
Combine ketchup, onions, garlic, vinegar, sugar, Worcestershire sauce, chili powder, mustard, and oregano in a bowl.
Pour the sauce over the chops and marinate in the refrigerator for at least 1 hour or up to 8 hours.
Cover with foil and bake in a 350°F oven for 30 minutes.
Uncover and bake, spooning sauce over chops occasionally, for 15 to 30 minutes or until tender.

_similar.name: Chili Turkey
_similar.description: A hearty chili turkey dish made with ground turkey, kidney beans, and whole wheat spaghetti.

recipeInstructions.text: Heat oil in a large heavy pot over medium heat. Add onion and cook, stirring occasionally, until it starts to brown, about 8 to 10 minutes.
Add garlic and cook for 1 minute.
Add the turkey and cook, stirring to coarsely crumble until no longer pink, about 8 to 10 minutes.
Stir in chili powder, tomato paste, broth, cinnamon, cumin, salt, coriander, and oregano. Bring to a simmer.
Partially cover and cook, stirring occasionally, until the meat is tender and the broth is slightly thickened.
Meanwhile, pour the beans (with juice) into a microwaveable bowl. Microwave on high for 1 to 2 minutes or until heated through. Drain and cover to keep warm.
Cook the pasta as directed.
Place pasta on a plate, ladle chili over pasta, and top with beans, then with cheese.

_similar.keywords: chili turkey, ground turkey, kidney beans, whole wheat spaghetti

_similar.name: Sweet & Sour Pineapple Chicken
_similar.description: A sweet and tangy chicken dish baked in a pineapple-based sauce, perfect for a comforting meal.
recipeIngredient: ⅗ cup (¼ cup + 2 Tbsp) crushed pineapple, drained

recipeInstructions.text: Simmer the chicken breasts in water until cooked through, turning occasionally.
In a pan, combine crushed pineapple, vinegar, brown sugar, salt, ketchup, and water. Cook over heat, stirring until the sauce thickens.
Place the cooked chicken in a casserole dish and pour the sweet and sour sauce over the top.
Cover the dish with tinfoil and bake at 325°F for 1½ hours.

_similar.keywords: sweet and sour chicken, pineapple chicken, baked chicken
